name: Insomnia
overview: Insomnia is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include disorder causing trouble with sleeping. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: From a clinical perspective, insomnia, also known as sleeplessness, is a sleep disorder causing difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep for as long as desired.
Health professionals note that insomnia is typically followed by daytime sleepiness, low energy, irritability, and a depressed mood.
In routine practice, it may result in an increased risk of accidents as well as problems focusing and learning.
Health professionals note that insomnia can be short-term, lasting for days or weeks, or long-term, lasting more than a month.
In routine practice, the concept of the word insomnia has two distinct possibilities: insomnia disorder or insomnia symptoms.
